# SPI Logistics

> > SPI Logistics provides independent freight agent programs, TMS technology, and back-office support for freight brokers and carriers.

SPI Logistics (SPI3PL) operates a 1099 independent freight agent model offering broker solutions, FMCSA-compliant training, carrier network management with TriumphPay integration, and comprehensive freight brokerage education. The platform serves freight agents, shippers, and carriers with technology-driven logistics services.

## Key Topics

- Independent freight agent programs
- FMCSA compliance and licensing
- TMS (Transportation Management System)
- Freight rate negotiation with DAT and Truckstop.com
- Carrier relationship management
- Freight broker technology and back-office support
- Truckload and LTL shipping strategies
- Freight claims management and liability
- Supply chain risk mitigation
- Bill of lading and customs compliance
- TriumphPay quick-pay integration
- Freight brokerage scaling strategies
- Remote team recruitment and training
- Flatbed and specialized freight
- Value-driven selling for brokers

## Core Programs & Solutions

- [The Independent Freight Agent Model](https://spi3pl.com/independent-freight-agent-model-the-future-of-brokerage): SPI's 1099 independent freight agent program overview and benefits
- [Freight Broker Solutions - Streamline Your Operations](https://spi3pl.com/freight-broker-solutions): SPI's TMS, carrier management, and compliance solutions for brokers
- [Full Trucks and Fast Carrier Payments--Join SPI](https://spi3pl.com/carrier-payments): SPI carrier network with TriumphPay quick-pay integration
- [Contact Us for 3PL Solutions and Freight Broker Support](https://spi3pl.com/contact): SPI Logistics contact form for brokers, shippers, and carriers
